When you're ready to build it out, just tell me what you want the pipeline to do and I'll help you add stages one at a time. For reference, the available stage types are:

| Type | What it does |
|---|---|
| `input_data` | Pulls data in from a source (connector) |
| `llm_transform` | Runs an LLM prompt over rows |
| `python_transform` | Applies a Python function to rows |
| `join` | Merges two streams on key columns |
| `aggregate` | Groups and aggregates rows |
| `human_review_queue` | Holds rows for a human to approve |
| `publish` | Outputs / exports the final result |
